mapper.select: select substr(add_time,1,10) as day, count(distinct id) as users from litemall_user where deleted = 0 group by substr(add_time,1,10) order by day

select substr(add_time,1,10) as day, count(id) as orders, count(distinct user_id) as customers, sum(case when order_status >= 201 then actual_price else 0 end) as amount, round(sum(case when order_status >= 201 then actual_price else 0 end)/count(distinct user_id),2) as pcr from litemall_order where deleted = 0 group by substr(add_time,1,10) order by day

select substr(add_time,1,10) as day, count(distinct order_id) as orders, sum(number) as products, sum(number*price) as amount from litemall_order_goods where deleted = 0 group by substr(add_time,1,10) order by day
